name: Box breathing
description: Equal sides: in, hold, out, hold. Steadying and simple.

name: 4-7-8 breath
description: A long, slow out-breath. Many people like it before sleep.

name: Calm
description: In for 4, out for 6. A gentle, longer exhale.

name: Energize
description: A brighter rhythm for a sleepy afternoon. Stop if you feel light-headed.
